title: 第25章 接受挑战第26章 日入百块灵石杀机毕现
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
赵升失魂落魄地跟在林渊身后，抱着那袋滚烫的灵石，却感觉像抱着一块烙铁。
他凑到林渊身边，压低了声音。
“师弟，你……你怎么就答应了啊……”
“赵师兄。”
林渊脚步未停，声音却如寒铁般冷静。
“如果什么都依着他们，今日这个来，明日那个来，我们辛辛苦苦赚来的灵石，岂不是都成了别人的俸禄？”
他侧头看了一眼赵升，目光清明而锐利。
“别人拿着我们赚的灵石提升修为，把我们踩在脚下。”
“而我们呢？”
“永远在泥潭里打滚，何时才能出头？”
“话是这么说，可是……”
赵升急得嘴唇发干。
“一旦不敌，如果被打成重伤，伤了根基，很可能这辈子道途就毁了呀！”
“放心，我有准备。”
林渊的语气平静得不像一个即将面对生死斗的炼气一层修士。
他的脑海中，已经在飞速盘算。
‘炼气三层，灵力比我雄厚数倍，硬拼是找死。’
‘但我的优势在于灵力精纯度和术法威力，只要抓住机会，一击制敌，并非不可能。’
‘三天，足够了。’
“对了，赵师兄，这擂台比斗，可以使用法器吗？”

“当然可以！”
赵升连忙道。
“不过，不能使用超过自身境界的法器。”
“所以，你们只能使用一阶法器。”
‘既然这样，那我还可以给他来点惊喜……’
赵升还是一脸凝重，林渊却已经走到了坊市边缘人少的地方。
他停下脚步，从赵升怀中拿过布袋，倒出十二块灵石，分出两块，塞回赵升手里。
“师兄，这是你的。”
“不！不不！”
赵升像被烫到一样，连连摆手。
“我就是帮着吆喝了几声，哪能拿这么多！”
“这使不得！”
“拿着。”
林渊不容置疑地将灵石按在他手中。
“没有你，我连摊位费都交不起。”
“以后，我们赚的，都这么分。”
赵升捧着那两块温润的灵石，眼眶一热，差点掉下泪来。
content_en:
Zhao Sheng followed Lin Yuan in despair, holding the bag of hot spiritual stones, but it felt like holding a soldering iron.
He moved closer to Lin Yuan and lowered his voice.
"Junior brother, you...why did you agree..."
"Senior Brother Zhao."
Lin Yuan's footsteps did not stop, but his voice was as calm as cold iron.
"If we depend on them for everything, if this comes today and that comes tomorrow, wouldn't the spiritual stones we have worked so hard to earn become someone else's salary?"
He glanced sideways at Zhao Sheng, his eyes clear and sharp.
"Others use the spiritual stones we earn to improve our cultivation and trample us under their feet."
"And what about us?"
"Walling in the quagmire forever, when will I be able to emerge?"
"That's what I said, but..."
Zhao Sheng's lips were so anxious that they were dry.
"Once you lose, if you are seriously injured and your foundation is damaged, it is very likely that your path in this life will be ruined!"
"Don't worry, I'm prepared."
Lin Yuan's tone was so calm that he didn't look like a first-level Qi-refining monk who was about to face a life-and-death battle.
His mind was already calculating rapidly.
'At the third level of Qi refining, your spiritual power is several times stronger than mine. If you fight hard, you are courting death. ’
‘But my advantages lie in the purity of my spiritual energy and the power of my spells. As long as I seize the opportunity, it is not impossible to defeat the enemy with one blow. ’
‘Three days is enough. ’
"By the way, Senior Brother Zhao, can you use magic weapons in this arena competition?"
"Of course!"
Zhao Sheng said quickly.
"However, you cannot use magic weapons that exceed your own realm."
"So, you can only use first-order magic weapons."
'In this case, I can give him a surprise...'
Zhao Sheng still had a serious look on his face, but Lin Yuan had already reached a place on the edge of Fang City where there were few people.
He stopped, took the cloth bag from Zhao Sheng's arms, poured out twelve spiritual stones, separated two pieces, and stuffed them back into Zhao Sheng's hand.
"Brother, this is yours."
"No! No no!"
Zhao Sheng waved his hands repeatedly as if he had been burned.
"I just helped and shouted a few times, how could I get so much!"
"This is impossible!"
"Take it."
Lin Yuan put the spirit stone in his hand without any doubt.
“Without you, I wouldn’t even be able to pay the stall fee.”
"From now on, everything we earn will be divided like this."
Zhao Sheng held the two warm spiritual stones, his eyes were hot and he almost shed tears.
